thread.title: Apple set to open as 2nd-biggest U.S. company, behind Microsoft

author: morningstar.com
title: Apple set to open as 2nd-biggest U.S. company, behind Microsoft
text:
With Apple Inc.'s stock (AAPL) shedding 2.1% in premarket trade Tuesday, after President Trump said he was considering tariffs on iPhones (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apples-stock-drops-as-trumps-tariffs-comments-add-to-investor-agita-analyst-says-2018-11-27), the technology giant is on track to open as justthe second-biggest U.S. company (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/microsofts-market-cap-jumps-to-within-4-billion-of-apples-2018-11-26) by market capitalization. Based on 4,745,398,000 shares outstanding as of Oct. 26, according to the latest quarterly filings, Apple's market cap would open at about $811.5 billion. Meanwhile, Microsoft Corp.'s stock (MSFT) was down 0.4% ahead of the open, which based on 7,676,218,736 shares outstanding as of Oct. 19 would put the software giant's market cap at about $813.8 billion. Since the end of October, Apple's market cap has declined by about $210 billion, while Microsoft's market cap has declined by about $2.6 billion. Apple's stock has shed 20% over the past three months while Microsoft shares have lost 2.9% and the Dow Jones Industrial Average has given up 5.4%.
-Tomi Kilgore; 0759ET
